user.title: Poltergeist
user.description: Estimate where people are in the house from motion and occupancy sensors that are assigned to areas. Nothing needs to be configured here.

init.title: Poltergeist
init.description: The highest number of people tracked in a room. Read the top count roughly as "this many or more". Motion and occupancy sensors cannot tell these counts apart; a higher value only matters once sensors that count people are added. Changing it reloads the integration.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Rooms are the areas of Home Assistant. Pick an area that has no room; the room starts with the motion and occupancy sensors that are in that area and not watching another room yet.

reconfigure.title: Sensors of {room}
reconfigure.description: The motion and occupancy sensors that watch this room. A sensor can only watch one room: choosing one that watches another room moves it here.

abort.all_areas_are_rooms: Every area of Home Assistant is already a room.
abort.area_gone: That area no longer exists. Select Add room again.
